Overview

Your holiday adventure in The Heart of Aggieland® starts at Santa’s Wonderland, the largest Christmas Park in the world! Stroll through millions of dazzling lights along the iconic Trail of Lights, enjoy real Texas snow and ice, hop on a hayride or cozy up in a horse-drawn carriage and capture unforgettable holiday photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus. Spanning more than 150 acres, the park features Santa’s Town, the West Pole, Santa’s Station and Santa’s Farm with its beloved petting zoo plus nightly live entertainment and endless shopping. With festive food around every corner—including the famous Texas-shaped funnel cake, hot tots and roasting-pit s’mores—Santa’s Wonderland is the ultimate holiday destination.
